description: Dynaset P over F at row 2; Clone C1 of P; Clone C2 of C1; read BOF, EOF and ID of each. C1.Close; C2.MoveNext and read ID; read C1's EOF; P.MoveNext and read ID; P.Close; C2.MoveNext, read ID and RecordCount; C2.Close. Then dynaset P2, Clones CA and CB: release CA without Close; read CB's EOF and ID; release P2 without Close; CB.MoveNext, read ID and RecordCount; CB.Close. Asks which close or release orders of a parent, clone and clone-of-clone leave the others usable, and the errors of the closed ones. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
